# Simona Gurrì

> Research Fellow at Politecnico di Torino (DENERG). Specialist in reactive CFD and combustion modeling of internal combustion engines running on low-carbon and alternative fuels (hydrogen, CNG, ethanol, methanol, with an emerging line on ammonia) for heavy-duty applications. Secondary expertise in sustainable freight-transport and mobility systems.

## About

Simona Gurrì holds a PhD in Energy Engineering (Politecnico di Torino, 2025, cum laude) and an MSc in Mechanical Engineering. Her core research is high-fidelity 3D reactive CFD of in-cylinder turbulence-chemistry interactions, injection and mixture formation, and combustion of low-carbon fuels, using CONVERGE, GT-Power and Cantera on HPC clusters. She also brings a system-level perspective from work on next-generation freight trains and intermodal transport.

She is Global Engagement Chair of the ASME DRIVN 2026 conference and Vice Chair of the ASME Italy Section. She is currently exploring postdoctoral and R&D opportunities in combustion, energy, and sustainable transport.

## Key topics

- Reactive CFD of internal combustion engines
- Combustion and turbulence modeling
- Low-carbon and alternative fuels (hydrogen, CNG, ethanol, methanol, ammonia)
- Chemical kinetics and reaction mechanism benchmarking
- Heavy-duty engines
- Sustainable freight transport and intermodal logistics
